record.field: purpose: SaltStack operations — ping, diagnosis (pillar/grains/minion/service/disk/memory/load/journal/process) and remediation (state.apply/highstate, cmd.run, service.restart, minion-accept) when: all work against Salt minions — troubleshooting and remediation when not: for Zabbix data (use the zabbix capability); for Odoo/web (other tools) example: {"operation": "salt_test_ping", "minion": "gw*"} then {"operation": "salt_service_status", "minion": "gw1", "service": "caddy"} output: per operation — see the respective operation description guardrail: remediation operations (state.apply, highstate, cmd.run, service.restart, minion_accept) require human approval; read operations run without

record.field: purpose: Zabbix monitoring — alerts, problems, host, metrics, triggers, host groups and acknowledgment when: all work against Zabbix — drift alerts, trend analysis, acknowledgment after remediation when not: for SaltStack data (use the salt capability) example: {"operation": "zabbix_get_alerts", "severity": "high"} then {"operation": "zabbix_get_problems", "host": "gw1"} then {"operation": "zabbix_acknowledge", "event_id": "123", "message": "Restarted caddy"} output: per operation — see the respective operation description guardrail: zabbix_acknowledge requires human approval (write — changes alert status); read operations run without
